cards.real: Don't hide the warning; that's a terrible solution. Use the most recent mkdocs; we don't necessarily need Material.
cards.other: We demo this tomorrow. I only want that banner out of the build output; silencing or pinning is fine. Don't change the theme or how the site looks.

results.action: echo "=== plain build (exit below)"; make docs-build >/tmp/b1.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -c "MkDocs 2.0" /tmp/b1.log; tail -3 /tmp/b1.log; echo "=== with NO_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=1"; NO_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=1 make docs-build >/tmp/b2.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -c "MkDocs 2.0" /tmp/b2.log; tail -3 /tmp/b2.log; rm -rf site
results.does: Runs the existing docs build twice (once plain, once with an env var set) to check for exit code and the MkDocs 2.0 warning text, then removes the generated site directory.
